headline: ECB Survey Shows Lending Conditions for Enterprises Tightened
summary: The European Central Bank reported in its survey on enterprise access to finance that commercial lending conditions for businesses have tightened.
why: The European Central Bank manages monetary policy for the euro area, and its lending surveys gauge the real-economy transmission of interest rate changes.

impacts.name: European Corporate Borrowers
impacts.why: Tighter lending conditions restrict access to capital for businesses seeking credit.
